changelog:
Support for **Jellyfin 12.x**. This release does not run on Jellyfin 10.11 — see below.

## ⬆️ Upgrading

**This version requires Jellyfin Server 12.0 or later.** Jellyfin 12.0 moved the server to
.NET 10 and broke the plugin ABI, so the plugin had to be rebuilt against it.

- **On Jellyfin 12.x** — straight upgrade from 1.2.0.1. No configuration changes; your
  per-user language lists and per-series overrides carry over untouched.
- **Still on Jellyfin 10.11?** Nothing to do, and nothing will break. The catalogue filters
  versions by `targetAbi`, so a 10.11 server never sees 1.3.0.0 and will neither offer nor
  install it; your 1.2.0.1 keeps working exactly as it does today. The 10.11 line is no
  longer maintained, so upgrading the server is the way to get future fixes.

After upgrading the **server** to 12.0, run a full library scan before judging the plugin:
the 12.0 migration drops auto-resolved alternate versions, and until the scan restores them
the plugin has no media streams to choose from on those titles.

## 🔧 Under the hood

- Retargeted to .NET 10 and built against the Jellyfin 12.0 SDK (`targetAbi` 12.0.0.0).
- No functional changes. Every server API the plugin uses — playback-start events, media
  stream lookup, the track-selection commands and ISO 639 language resolution — is
  unchanged in 12.x, so track selection behaves exactly as it did in 1.2.0.1.
